def _fix_imports(py_file: Path) -> None:
    """Rewrite top-level pb2 imports to package-relative ones.

    protoc emits ``import other_pb2 as x`` / ``from other_pb2 import ...``
    which breaks inside the ``abc_db.gen`` package; rewrite to ``from
    abc_db.gen import other_pb2 as x`` / ``from abc_db.gen.other_pb2 import``.
    """
    text = py_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

    def repl(match: re.Match[str]) -> str:
        if match.group("mod"):
            return f"from abc_db.gen import {match.group('mod')}"
        return f"from abc_db.gen.{match.group('frm')} import "

    text = _IMPORT_RE.sub(repl, text)
    py_file.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")", "old_string": "_IMPORT_RE = re.compile(r"^(import|from) ([a-zA-Z0-9_]+_pb2)(?: import)? ")


def _fix_imports(py_file: Path) -> None:
    """Rewrite top-level pb2 imports to package-relative ones.

    protoc emits ``import other_pb2`` / ``from other_pb2 import ...`` which
    breaks inside the ``abc_db.gen`` package; rewrite to ``from abc_db.gen
    import other_pb2`` / ``from abc_db.gen.other_pb2 import ...``.
    """
    text = py_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

    def repl(match: re.Match[str]) -> str:
        kw, mod = match.group(1), match.group(2)
        if kw == "import":
            return f"from abc_db.gen import {mod}\n"
        return f"from abc_db.gen.{mod} import "

    text = _IMPORT_RE.sub(repl, text)
    py_file.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")"}
